name: Ura Mihoko
source:
A quiet madam who frequents the yume-no-ra coastline.

Her husband is a deputy general manager of the business promotion department of a major trading company. 

 Mihoko's husband has given her a life without any inconvenience and making it boring for her. She has developed a taste for food, clothing, and housing in her privileged life. She has a great sense of taste in all things.

She is good friends with Tsukiyo, the mother of the heroine Runa, and often consults with her about the interior design and menu of her restaurant. Tetsuya looks like her first love, which makes her heart flutter every day. She is a fan of the Bond girl style swimsuits of a decade ago.
